home.historia_p1: Casa Vendrell was born in a restored 1934 winery, where every decision sought to preserve the essence and original elements of the space. The result is a place with its own history, in the heart of l'Eixample.
home.historia_p2: A wine bar run by its own owners, passionate and focused on guiding the experience on every visit. A great selection of wines and a tapas menu where each dish accompanies and complements the protagonist.
home.consultoria_p1: Casa Vendrelll emerges from the sum of different perspectives on the same goal.
home.consultoria_p2: That same vision is what we offer to those who want to bring their own project to life: from the initial idea to the launch, accompanying each stage of the process with criteria, experience and sensitivity.
